closure_conditions.QNT-03: Dependence-aware controls or calibrated effective sample treatment match the hypothesis; contributor lineage is retained.
closure_conditions.QNT-04: All inspected data and overlapping label windows have recorded use; appropriate held-out/purged evaluation is reproducible.
closure_conditions.QNT-05: Registered admission rule and sequential/family budget are evidenced, retained and respected across retries/restarts.

QNT-03: Dependence-aware control: admission uses max(dependence-corrected consistency p, common-rotation p); both must exist and clear the existing configured threshold; no threshold changed.

Pooling does not create independent evidence: shared-factor test has 8 distinct inputs, measured null rho >0.5, effective n <3, corrected p no smaller than the independent diagnostic; 8 exact alias copies contribute at most one scored unit.

Contributor lineage retained: every contributor, frame/signal/funding fingerprints, WRLD-07 model/version/scope/evidence references and a receipt hash; reload plus a fresh interpreter reproduces the numerical result and receipt.
Baseline gaps fixed: 45e825d admitted 15 shared votes at independent p ~3e-15 with no dependence evidence; referee silently dropped 7 of 28 unmeasured pairs and treated unaligned calendars as common.
QNT-04: Training/selection separated from held-out: discovery holds no bar at/after the cut; B starts at the cut (existing slices/referee tests plus new partition test).
Point-in-time labels / future-label leakage control: rewriting every price after the cut leaves the discovery bundle byte-identical.
Later revision/growth cannot leak: demonstrated gap (cut drifted forward as the store grew, exposing spent B bars) fixed; with cap_ms the discovery bundle equals the original.

Reused held-out refused: record_test raises holdout_already_spent, set_candidate cannot restore a spent candidate to queued/deferred, _examine refuses a spent rule without a look; the cut stays frozen at the first spent look across restart; replay gives an identical split and bundle.
Missing/insufficient held-out evidence yields no frames (not a pass).
QNT-05: Explicit family/sequential budget: one LORD++ sequence whose index is the research_tests table; parameters registered once in research_budget.
Correct consumption: looks take steps 1..n in order; alpha never rises without a rejection.

Retry/restart/reset: a restart does not restore budget; a config change after spending (higher fdr_target/lord_w0) is ignored and a caller using it is refused unregistered_alpha, also across restart; a failed look is charged p=1 at max attempts and does not reset.
Duplicate/renamed candidate: same canonical hash hits the QNT-04 spent guard; a second spend raises holdout_already_spent.
Exhausted budget: _examine defers, spends nothing, state deferred. Unregistered threshold: record_test raises unregistered_alpha, nothing recorded.
